detail.longDescription:
When a YouTube embed is placed further down a page and the video is no longer available ("Video unavailable"), the page automatically scrolls down to that video frame on load. This scrolling does not occur with available videos. Minimal reproducible example:
Does anyone know a way to prevent this automatic scrolling on my own page? EDIT: It looks like YouTube has fixed the problem; at least for now (on 23.11.2026), I can't reproduce the issue anymore.
